com.guicedee.modules.services:graphql-java 2.2.0 发布, A JPMS modularized shade of GraphQL-Java (com.graphql-java:graphql-java) exposing the
        com.graphqljava module for a clean GuicedEE / jlink pipeline. ANTLR remains relocated
        internally by GraphQL-Java under the graphql.org.antlr.* namespace. The stale Guava copy
        that GraphQL-Java bundles under graphql.com.google.common.* is stripped out of this shade and
        its references are rewritten back to com.google.common.* so the module reuses the canonical
        com.google.guava:guava (module com.google.common) already shipped by GuicedEE. This avoids
        duplicating Guava and removes the security risk of an out-of-date, embedded copy.

    slice 2): an S3BlobStore on AWS SDK for Java v2 (Apache-2.0), selected by
    tesseraql.object-storage.provider: s3 and discovered through the BlobStoreProvider ServiceLoader
    (the PdfEngine idiom). One module covers AWS S3 and every compatible store (Cloudflare R2, Ceph,

    simply omit this jar, so the AWS SDK stays out of their deployment. Integration tests run against
